claim: Corrected DERD may provide a compact descriptor for a restricted subset of single-period pulsating-star light curves.
falsifier: Inferior or non-noninferior held-out performance, structured residuals, unstable parameters, failed uncertainty calibration, or failure on prespecified star strata.
next_gate: Complete data, frozen multi-class development set, calibrated uncertainty, and one-time sealed holdout evaluation.

phase03_gate.uncertainty_result: DERD intervals under-covered the nominal 90% level on this sparse population.
